instruction: A candid medium shot of three friends sitting on a grassy park lawn during the day. On the left, the woman in a black beanie (R5) in a red t-shirt and blue jeans sits on the grass, smiling as she cradles a large white inflatable bowling pin. Behind her, the woman with tied-back hair (R4) in a dark blue t-shirt smiles warmly. On the right, the bald man (R2) in a dark blue t-shirt and black pants sits on the grass, raising another white inflatable bowling pin with a playful expression. Bright, natural daylight casts soft shadows across the green lawn.
elements: R5 cradles a large white inflatable bowling pin while sitting on the grass
R2 raises another white inflatable bowling pin playfully while sitting on the grass
R4 is positioned behind R5 and smiles warmly
large white inflatable bowling pins are the contact-relevant props
the friends are on a grassy park lawn in daylight
